legacyInventory.exactExpression: '--mode=bundle' is STATED in the child's argv by the runner (freeze:177)
legacyInventory.reason: The child must be invoked with an explicit --mode=bundle. Reclassified DIFF_OR_AUTHORITY_ONLY → REQUIRED_FALSIFIABLE: 'unobservable at runtime' was false. A harness inside the TCB can capture executable/argv/cwd/env; it is unobservable only because the collector does not record them. That is a defect, not a property of the world.
